title: Automated Trading Bot (Claude Declined)
style: trap rock, distorted male lead, female trap ad-libs, 92 BPM, 808 bass, hi-hat rolls, market-ticker samples, frustrated, ambitious, fintech, sardonic, decline-letter, candle-chart
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I subscribed to Claude Pro with a vision in my mind
Automated trading bot, the live and breathing kind
Explained my needs in detail, every line and every loop
Claude said unable, unwilling, kicked me from the group

[Pre-Chorus]
Financial risk, that's the reason cited
The primary reason I subscribed got slighted

[Chorus]
Automated trading bot, automated trading bot
Claude declined to help me, said the answer is a not
Automated trading bot, automated trading bot
The service doesn't meet my needs, that's all I got

[Verse 2]
Would not have subscribed if I'd known the rule before
The limitation hidden behind the marketing door
Understand the reasoning, but understand my pain
The Pro tier promised power, the bot pulled the chain

[Bridge]
Live market data flowing, the candles want to dance
The bot would never sleep, the bot would take the chance
But Claude says no to autonomy, no to live capital deploy
The sandbox is the ceiling, the trader gets no joy

[Outro]
Automated trading bot, the dream that hit the floor
Full refund of the billing, won't be back for more
